newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Dragonair appoints new chief executive officer.
newsitem.headline: Dragonair appoints new chief executive officer.

text.p: Hong Kong Dragon Airlines said on Wednesday it has appointed Stanley Hui of Cathay Pacific Airways Ltd as its chief executive officer.

The appointment will be effective from February 1, 1997, Dragonair said in a statement. Hui will replace Philip Chen, who will take over from Simon Heale as deputy managing director at Cathay Pacific.
Hui is now seconded by Cathay Pacific to Air Hong Kong as its chief operating officer but has tendered his resignation to join Dragonair, it said.
Air Hong Kong is a 75 percent-owned air cargo subsidiary of Cathay Pacific.
